statement: In the case of quantum polynomial time, Adleman et al. [1] showed how the choice of amplitudes can affect the expressivity of classes such as bqp, requiring the restriction of polynomial-time approximable complex amplitudes. How the set of amplitudes influences the class fbqpolylog remains an open question, as discussed in [20, 21], and so we abstain from the use of the entire set of complex numbers and instead use a field K which may refer to, for instance, polynomial-time approximable complex amplitudes.
